host_or_major_command: Air Force District of Washington / 316th Wing (host wing)
primary_mission_summary: Joint Base Andrews is a National Capital Region joint installation hosted by the 316th Wing. The 316th Wing provides security, personnel, contracting, finance, infrastructure, and airfield support for multiple wings, headquarters, and tenant organizations, supports NCR contingency response with rotary-wing assets, and secures one of the world's highest-visibility flight lines. The 89th Airlift Wing, an Air Mobility Command tenant, provides global Special Air Mission airlift, logistics, aerial port, and communications for the President, Vice President, cabinet members, and other senior leaders.
mission_partners: 459th Air Refueling Wing (Air Force Reserve Command)
316th Medical Group / Malcolm Grow Medical Clinics and Surgery Center
pcs_personality: High-cost, commute-sensitive, school-zone-sensitive, federal-employment-connected, mission-visible, traffic-heavy, and strongly influenced by Prince George's County, Charles County, DC, Northern Virginia, and National Capital Region housing decisions.
base_bluf: Andrews is a National Capital Region housing decision, not just a base commute decision. Families must balance BAH fit, taxes, traffic, school zones, HOA exposure, spouse employment, security/access procedures, and assignment length before choosing rent or buy.

That is a host-wing published profile, not a live installation census and not a complete Joint Base Andrews headcount of all tenant wings, Naval Air Facility Washington, headquarters staffs, contractors, and family members. The same factsheet's '60,000 Airmen and families in the National Capital Region and around the world' is a support-population statement, not on-installation population. Surrounding Camp Springs, Prince George's County, and Washington, D.C. civilian population figures are not installation population and are not used here. access_guidance.bluf: Joint Base Andrews is a closed installation. Visitors without an accepted DoD access credential must use the Visitor Control Center, present REAL ID-compliant identification or another accepted credential, and should verify current access requirements before travel.
current_posture: Official JBA VCC guidance states the installation is closed and proper identification is required to gain access.

Accepted identification listed on the current official VCC page includes DoD Common Access Cards, military retiree ID cards, military dependent ID cards, state/federal law enforcement on official business, and sponsored guests such as DBIDS card holders.
As of 7 May 2025, official JBA guidance states all visitors need a REAL ID-compliant driver's license or other acceptable identification for base access.
The official VCC page states it cannot provide operator or base-locator services; use the base operator at 301-981-1110 for those requests.
Gate and Visitor Control Center hours are time-sensitive and should be checked immediately before travel.

gate_selection_logic: Start with the user's likely duty location.
Identify the most realistic 24/7 gate (currently Main Gate).
Check Virginia Gate and Pearl Harbor Gate only as optional commute helpers during published hours.
Do not plan on North Gate based on the current official outbound-closed listing.
Compare the commute during the user's actual report window.
Do not choose a neighborhood based only on mileage.
planning_guidance: Test the commute during the user’s expected report-time window.
Confirm which gate best supports the user’s duty location.
Compare Camp Springs, Upper Marlboro, Clinton, Waldorf, Bowie, Brandywine, Fort Washington, and selected Northern Virginia corridors by route reliability, not only distance.
Use commute plus all-in housing cost as the core PCSUnited decision screen.
commute_intelligence.user_instruction: Before signing a lease or contract, users should test the commute from the exact property address to the expected gate during the same time window they would normally report to work. Times are approximate and depend on gate, traffic, and exact address.
commute_intelligence.pcsu_bluf: For Andrews, commute risk can outweigh small payment differences. The best housing choice balances BAH fit, gate logic, traffic, schools, HOA, taxes, spouse employment, and assignment length.

bah_market_reality.bah_bluf: Andrews should be modeled as a high-cost but stable National Capital Region market. BAH is a decision filter, not a promise of affordability. Compare BAH against rent or mortgage, taxes, HOA, insurance, commute, debt, and assignment length.

bah_market_reality.renting_summary: Renting remains practical for shorter assignments, users with tight residual income, households still learning the DC metro, or families avoiding transaction-cost risk.

pcs_watchouts.title: Gate and VCC hours can change
pcs_watchouts.message: Use the official Joint Base Andrews Visitor Control Center page immediately before travel. As of 2026-09-15, Main Gate is listed 24/7, Virginia Gate 5 a.m.-9 p.m., Pearl Harbor inbound 5 a.m.-4 p.m. / outbound 5 a.m.-6 p.m., West Gate pedestrian inbound weekday mornings only, North Gate outbound closed, and the VCC is closed Sundays and federal holidays.

pcs_watchouts.title: Visitor access procedures are security-sensitive
pcs_watchouts.message: JBA is a closed installation. Visitors should follow current identification, sponsorship, and REAL ID requirements. For access concerns, contact the VCC at 301-981-0232 / 301-981-0689.

pcs_watchouts.title: Distance is not the same as commute
pcs_watchouts.message: Neighborhoods should be compared by realistic gate access, duty location, Beltway/Route 5/301 traffic, and report-time windows. Times are approximate and depend on gate, traffic, and exact address.

pcs_watchouts.title: School assignments are residence-specific
pcs_watchouts.message: Maryland is not a public school-of-choice state. Verify school assignment by exact property address. Do not assume Imagine Andrews or any named community school is automatically available.

pcs_watchouts.title: BAH is not the full affordability picture
pcs_watchouts.message: Do not assume BAH automatically covers comfortable ownership in the National Capital Region. Compare rent or mortgage against income, debt, utilities, taxes, insurance, HOA, savings goals, and assignment length.

pcs_watchouts.title: Published population is host-wing profile, not a live installation census
pcs_watchouts.message: The 316th Wing factsheet publishes approximately 9,238 total force, 7,412 military, and 1,920 civilians. That is not a complete tenant-inclusive installation headcount and is not Camp Springs, Prince George's County, or Washington, D.C. population.

pcs_watchouts.title: Lodging and housing-office details have source conflicts
pcs_watchouts.message: Presidential Inn phones 301-909-8987 and 301-981-4614 both appear on official pages. Commissary phone/hours differ between DeCA corporate, shop.commissaries.com, and MyAirForceBenefits. Use the contacts in this profile and verify before travel.

pcs_watchouts.title: On-base housing is not automatically the best financial answer
pcs_watchouts.message: Compare availability, BAH treatment, commute, home fit, schools, and lifestyle before deciding. Short assignments may favor renting or on-base housing if resale risk is high.

pcs_watchouts.title: Spouse employment location can change the best housing corridor
pcs_watchouts.message: NCR dual-commute households may need a different corridor than a base-only commute. Test both work locations during expected report windows.

realtor_intelligence.best_client_positioning: Lead with BAH realism, commute testing, all-in monthly cost, school-zone verification, and corridor strategy. Andrews clients need a National Capital Region decision guide, not generic Maryland market advice.
